name: Self Righteous
overview: Scripture reveals that self-righteousness is a dangerous condition where individuals trust in their own perceived goodness rather than submitting to God's righteousness. Isaiah 64:6 starkly describes human efforts at righteousness as 'filthy rags,' emphasizing our inherent sinfulness. Jesus' parable in Luke 18:9 warns against the pride of those who consider themselves righteous and look down on others. Romans 3:10 confirms that no one is truly righteous on their own, and Romans 10:3 highlights the futility of trying to establish personal righteousness apart from God's gift. Salvation, as Ephesians 2:8 teaches, is by grace through faith, not by human works or self-justification.
